note: How each outstanding activity is actually assessed. 'mode' and 'evidence' are observed from the archived Kiro course pages (data/raw/kiro/course-*.html) and the published exam calendars. 'effort' is a judgement call, not data: it ranks how much work a bare pass (18/30) plausibly takes given the material available, and should be overridden freely. Courses marked 'on Kiro but not enrolled' exist on the platform but hide their contents until self-enrolment, so their effort rating is the least evidenced in this file.
source: Kiro course pages archived 2026-07-31; Regolamento L-AI 2025/26 art. 10 (no prerequisites, no attendance obligation); exam-rule documents and all 35 enrolled course instances archived 2026-07-31

modes.coursework: graded on submitted work; no sit-down exam to schedule
modes.project: a project replaces or dominates the written exam
modes.assignment_plus_exam: assignments during the course plus a written exam
